comment: The Phasor input is read with getVoltage per channel rather than getPolyVoltage, so a one-channel cable feeds channel one and leaves the rest of a polyphonic patch at 0V. PhasorEuclidean.cpp:157 reads FILLMODE_SCALE_PARAM into fillModeCVDepth and never uses it; :177 scales the Fill Mode CV jack by fillCVDepth, the Fill CV Depth knob times 64/5, so the Fill Limit Mode CV Depth knob does nothing and the fill mode jack is attenuated by the fill knob and dead when that knob sits at zero.
